title: Scrap Pirates Story Snippets Response V8
description: Draft AI-authoring contract. Defines additive story snippets that can begin with dialogue, progress through missions and encounters, and write localized world memories. The host owns eligibility, presentation, single-commit progression, journal lifecycle, and game mechanics. Story snippets are an unordered graph connected only by explicit prerequisites; array order never implies progress. Omit optional fields when unused. A conversation node is shown automatically when eligible and its speaker is available; no contact-action menu is required. V8 simplifies mission journaling to create/overwrite/append/complete, using one text field; title is required only when creating a mission journal entry. Journal resolution is described in prose and in the functional story outcome, not a separate result field.

locationRef.description: Location where these mission offers were generated. This is also the default location for mission contacts and scenes when they omit their own location.

cargoDefinitions.description: Mission-specific cargo types used by these chains. Region responses do not define cargo.

contacts.description: Characters introduced by these missions. Once created, these contacts remain part of the world after mission completion.

storySnippets.description: Unordered story graph for this response, containing dialogue, events, objectives, and encounters. Every snippet has a unique stable id in the persisted world. Include explicit prerequisites on non-entry nodes; omission creates an intentional eligible entry point. The host decides when to present eligible snippets, does not use array order, and commits outcomes at most once.

entryContacts.description: Stable IDs of contacts from the contacts definitions in this response that the host creates or reuses once when this story content is first installed. Use for story-entry speakers, not for contacts whose creation should follow a player choice. Contacts in definitions but not in entryContacts must be created by StoryFunction CreateContact or already exist in the persisted world. The host validates references and makes entry contacts present at their defined locations before first eligibility evaluation.

id.description: Stable ID used to reference this mission cargo type.

name.description: Player-facing name of the cargo item.

unitsPerItem.description: Cargo-capacity units per item. Omit for the usual value of 1.

questOnly.description: Whether ordinary selling or disposal is blocked. Omit for the usual mission-cargo value of true; set false only when this mission-created cargo should behave like ordinary tradable cargo.

id.description: Stable world ID for the contact. Mission cleanup does not delete the resulting contact.

factionRef.description: Faction this contact belongs to. Omit when unaffiliated.

locationRef.description: Persistent home/base location. Omit to use the response locationRef.

systemRef.description: Star-system address associated with the contact when they are encountered in space.

shipCardRef.description: Ship-card definition used when this contact is tied to a ship.

role.description: What this character does and what generally motivates their behavior.

appearanceBrief.description: Concise visual description used for portraits and consistent presentation.

secretInfo.description: Hidden durable character context for narrative generation. Omit when there is nothing secret to preserve.

kind.description: Creates or reuses a mission-defined persistent contact.

contactRef.description: ID of a contact defined in the story response. Creation does not automatically reveal it to the player.

kind.description: Creates a persistent ship instance needed by the mission.

shipId.description: Stable ID for the created ship instance.

shipCardRef.description: Ship-card definition used to build the ship manifest.

factionRef.description: Faction that owns or operates the ship.

systemRef.description: Star-system address where the ship is initially placed.

contactRef.description: Optional mission contact associated with the ship.

kind.description: Changes the captain’s credits as a committed mission effect.

delta.description: Signed credit change. Positive values pay the captain; negative values charge them.

kind.description: Starts a combat encounter using already-created mission ships.

encounterKey.description: Globally unique stable encounter key in the persisted story graph; no Chain-local namespace exists.

shipRefs.description: Existing ship instance IDs taking part as hostile opponents; the engine validates all references.

kind.description: Requests a validated update to an existing location after a story consequence.

locationRef.description: Stable location ID to update; the update must not replace the location’s identity.

prompt.description: Plain-language description of what changed and what existing facts should be preserved.

kind.description: Requests a validated update to an existing persistent contact after a story consequence.

contactRef.description: Stable contact ID to update; the update must preserve the contact’s identity.

prompt.description: Plain-language description of what changed and what established character facts should remain intact.

kind.description: Requires a particular committed combat result.

encounterRef.description: Globally unique key for a prior engine encounter result. Never infer from narrative.

outcome.description: Required encounter result, such as victory, escaped, or defeated.

EncounterOutcomePrerequisite.description: True only after the engine commits the named result of a specific encounter.

kind.description: Requires every nested prerequisite to be satisfied.

conditions.description: Prerequisites that must all be true.

kind.description: Requires at least one nested prerequisite to be satisfied.

conditions.description: Alternative prerequisites; any one may unlock the scene.

label.description: Short player-facing button or response label.

kind.description: Shows stored dialogue without completing the scene.

narrative.description: Stored dialogue shown immediately without a new text request.

LocalDialogueChoice.description: Reveals authored dialogue within the current snippet without committing an outcome or changing snippet eligibility.

kind.description: Changes the captain’s mission cargo after normal capacity/ownership validation.

delta.description: Signed item-count change. Positive values add cargo; negative values remove it.

kind.description: Adds a durable narrative memory to a faction, location, or contact when a story outcome commits.

targetType.description: Type of world entity that receives the log.

targetRef.description: Stable ID of the faction, location, or contact that receives the log.

statement.description: Concise narrative fact this entity should remember from the mission event. Write durable context, not transient dialogue.

importance.description: Relative retention priority among this entity’s logs; higher-importance memories are kept longer. Calibrate roughly: 1–10 is a notable event that makes the entity remember the player; 10–100 elicits an emotional response or affects the entity personally/materially; 100–1000 is a foundational change such as an existential issue or worldview revelation. Boundary ranges intentionally overlap; choose importance relative to the entity’s other memories.

StoryFunction.description: Validated engine effect to commit atomically and exactly once with the selected StorySnippet outcome. Do not use to start or progress a mission journal; use the StorySnippet.mission.onOutcome journal event. Effect arrays are applied in listed order after preflight validation. StartEncounter should be last.

RevealLocationFunction.description: PROPOSED NEW ENGINE CAPABILITY: reveals navigation to an existing location; does not teleport the captain or grant access.

locationRef.description: Existing location to expose on the captain navigation/map.

SetLocationAccessFunction.description: PROPOSED NEW ENGINE CAPABILITY: grants or revokes captain access to an existing restricted location; engine enforces availability.

locationRef.description: Existing location with engine-enforced access rules.

access.description: Granted allows engine access; Denied revokes it. No teleport or forceful ejection is implied.

StoryOutcomePrerequisite.description: True only after the referenced StorySnippet committed exactly the named outcome.

snippetRef.description: Stable ID of another story snippet, never an array index.

outcome.description: Declared outcome token of the referenced snippet.

StoryPrerequisite.description: Explicit eligibility rule for this snippet. Omitting this field declares an intentional story entry point: it is eligible subject to current place, speaker presence, and host arbitration. Never omit this merely because an earlier snippet appears before it in the JSON array. The host evaluates only committed outcomes, not prose or logs.

label.description: Concise, meaningful player-facing option. Different choices should imply a real narrative difference.

narrative.description: Optional authored line shown after selection and before the next snippet; omit when unnecessary.

outcome.description: One of the owning snippet outcomes. The host commits the outcome, matching outcomeEffects and journal event exactly once.

GeneratedResponseChoice.description: Optional guided AI interaction inside the current snippet. The host can always offer freeform input even without this choice. The DM can continue speaking or propose one of this snippet's declared outcomes; it may not directly invent game effects.

label.description: Visible example of an open-ended player intent.

generationIntent.description: Plain language signal for the live DM, such as ChallengeClaim or Negotiate; this is not an engine operation.

StoredChoice.description: Player-facing response. Authored choices are helpful guidance, not a prohibition on freeform actions. The host never invents mechanical effects for a local dialogue line.

MissionJournalEvent.description: A single player-facing mission journal mutation committed only after the enclosing story snippet commits the keyed outcome. Journal updates are presentation, not progress predicates; they never trigger on eligibility or display. Use AddLog for durable contact/faction/location history instead.

operation.description: create: make a new active journal entry with title and text; overwrite: replace the full journal body, retaining its original title and active state; append: add text as a separate paragraph; complete: append the closing text and mark the journal entry inactive. Completion meaning (success, failure, abandonment) is in the outcome and text, not a journal result enum.

title.description: Player-facing mission title; required for create and not permitted for other operations. The host retains the title on subsequent mutations.

text.description: Only player-facing journal body field. On create, initial mission description/objective; on overwrite, complete replacement body; on append, a new paragraph; on complete, closing paragraph explaining the resolution.

MissionJournalBinding.description: Optional tracked player-mission journal mutations, independent of StorySnippet.kind and distinct from entity AddLog history. Mutations run once on the keyed committed outcome; create must precede append/overwrite/complete for the same missionRef. A completed journal is inactive. The engine uses story outcomes to decide progression and narrative text to describe resolution.

missionRef.description: Stable player mission journal ID, shared by all snippets contributing to that mission. create makes a new entry under this ID; other operations mutate the existing active entry.

onOutcome.description: Map of this snippet’s declared outcome tokens to one journal mutation each. Keys must be a subset of StorySnippet.outcomes (checked by the host). Omit entries when the outcome has no meaningful player-facing journal change.

StorySnippet.description: One independently addressable narrative beat in an unordered world story graph. ConversationNode and MissionNode share the same prerequisites, outcomes, choices, and outcome effects. ConversationNode is dialogue with an available speaker; MissionNode is a non-dialogue event, encounter, or objective (and may optionally have a speaker). Mission journal participation is controlled solely by the optional mission field. Showing a snippet does not commit an outcome, start a mission, or execute effects. An active conversation automatically advances to the next eligible ConversationNode at this location, without an extra Talk action.

id.description: Globally unique stable ID in the persisted world story graph. References resolve by ID, never array order.

kind.description: Presentation style, not mission membership. ConversationNode requires speakerRef; MissionNode can still update the mission journal.

location.description: Existing V6 place reference: either dockable location ID or star-system address. Omit to use this response's locationRef. Do not invent locations.

prerequisite.description: Explicit committed-outcome dependency; omit only for intentional story entry points.

speakerRef.description: Contact who speaks in this node. Required for ConversationNode and must be created and present. The host does not teleport missing contacts.

narrative.description: Player-facing opening of this beat. For dialogue write specific, consequential speech; avoid exposition-only or evasive filler.

secrets.description: Hidden information for the DM to interpret unexpected player responses. Never reveal automatically.

outcomes.description: Allowed tokens this node may commit, including decisions interpreted by the live DM. Only committed outcomes affect progression.

storedChoices.description: Optional guided choices. The player may also reply in freeform; freeform DM can choose only an outcome declared here or continue in the node.

outcomeEffects.description: Maps an outcome token to validated engine effects. Keys MUST be declared in outcomes; the host checks. Effects belong to outcomes, not individual buttons, so typed freeform replies and stored choices that commit the same outcome have identical mechanical consequences. No effects fire on display.

mission.description: Optional outcome-based mission log updates; not world-entity AddLog history. Can appear on either snippet kind.

systemRef.description: Published hacked gate address. Grants a persistent, idempotent destination credential; never executable content.
